QuestInfo.name: [Morass] A Boy and A Girl
QuestInfo.0: You need to learn more about Tana. Use the portal in the #bPath to the Coral Forest 5#k to head to #bwhere Coastal Cats appear#k.
QuestInfo.1: Jean fed all your coins to the cats! Retrieve the \n#bKritias Coins#k from #bStreet Cat Area and \nStreet Cat Area 2#k.
QuestInfo.2: Disaster has struck. Many lives were lost, but #rTana#k somehow revived in the disaster zone. How could this be?

0.msg: Hunt the #bNameless Cat#k and gather Kritias Coins.
